text:
Alex Kim: evening swap — quick handoff for the 16:40 UTC streaming incident (:rotating_light:). summary below, stay sharp.
Priya Singh: +1. I handled the page earlier — sending timeline and what we changed.
Priya Singh: 16:38 UTC most long-lived streams to ap-southeast-2 started seeing partial frames and then hung until client timeout. client error rate ~7% p95 for ~30m.
Priya Singh: immediate cause looks like the multiplexor process hitting a keepalive/ephemeral port exhaustion combo after ~2k simultaneous long-lived connections. reproduces locally with load tests.
Priya Singh: mitigation we did: 1) shifted ~60% of sydney traffic to us-east-1 via smart-routing policy, 2) rolled multiplexor service (rolling) to cut stale fd table, 3) raised kernel ephemeral port range and tuned keepalive on pods.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3547 — Streaming Multiplexor APAC partial outputs. Severity: SEV3. Pager sent to @Priya.
Dan O'Leary: confirmed client retries handled most requests after routing shift. no message loss, just increased latency/partial output before retry.
Marta R.: any customer facing notes? Should we open an advisory or just post in status?
Priya Singh: customers A, C had detectable impact (mainly streaming SDK users in APAC). ops-notes drafted, will post controlled status update if no regression in next hour.
Alex Kim: runbook references — follow steps in runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/streaming-multiplexor#ephemeral-ports
Priya Singh: main runbook snippets used:
```shell
# quick drain then restart
kubectl rollout restart deployment/multiplexor -n inference
# bump kernel settings (kube node daemonset)
sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range="15000 61000"
```
Priya Singh: note: we added a temporary custom healthcheck that forces drain for connections >300s to avoid rebuild storms. config PR: https://git.redwood/infra/1234
Dan O'Leary: I'm taking secondary for remainder of evening. @Priya you'll stay primary until 21:00 UTC as planned? can hand off at 20:50 UTC if stable.
Priya Singh: yes I can hand over 20:50 UTC. main outstanding risk: the autoscaler might bring up many pods quickly and we can hit the same kernel limit on new nodes if not provisioned with tuned sysctl. I opened an infra ticket to bake sysctl into node bootstrap: INFRA-782.
Alex Kim: coverage gaps: APAC midnight window in two days has reduced oncall coverage — mitigation: schedule a redundancy check and make sure runbook + playbook pinned to the console for night ops.
Marta R.: action items for next shift (summary for the incoming oncall):
- Verify multiplexor healthchecks and connection counts (metrics: multiplexor.connections, fd_usage)
- Confirm node bootstrap sysctl rollout progress (owner: infra)
- Monitor client retry rates and increase routing spill threshold if latencies spike
- Post customer-facing update if any regression >5% affected calls in next 2 hours
Dan O'Leary: I'll add those to the oncall checklist and link the dashboards: https://console.redwood/d/streaming/multiplexor
Priya Singh: misc notes: we added an automated fallback route to fallback-model-1 for streaming sessions older than 60s to reduce strain; it's currently enabled only for ap-southeast-2.
Alex Kim: next steps — primary to watch for 30m, if stable handoff at 20:50 to Dan. If issues recur, escalate to SEV2 and page infra for node changes.
Priya Singh: leaving logs snippet for followups:
```
ERR multiplexor: accept: too many open files
stack: netpoll epoll_wait
```
Priya Singh: thanks all — @Dan take it from me at 20:50. I'll be available on pager/DM for the handover.
Dan O'Leary: acknowledged. I'll post a short handoff note at 20:50 with current metrics and whether the routing spill remains enabled.
Marta R.: added a note to the shift-runbook: "check ephemeral port range and fd limits before approving autoscaler scale-up".
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: handoff-check at 20:50 UTC to @Dan @Priya (via /remind)
Alex Kim: closing the summary here. any other add-ons before we wrap? :thumbsup:
Priya Singh: nothing else. all good on my side.
Dan O'Leary: ok, will assume primary after 20:50.
Marta R.: thanks team.
